author: Rotinpeaches
quote:
First of all, as a game, GTA has done an incredible job to the details, technical and graphical finesse, as well as the gigantic size of the map. If it was released under a different name, by a different publisher, without all the hype, marketing and delays, my score would be different. Hypocritical? Not really, and here is why. 

From as early as the top down GTA 1, GTA 2, GTA London series, the series has always considered a certain theme, a woven thread that would expand and come back with every new generation. A theme that you would instantly recognize the moment you started playing. A theme not influenced by politics or world events. 

And that's where GTA 6 has lost its plot majorly. Games are supposed to be places to escape reality, to be immersed in a fantasy world where creative expression is not limited in any way. And that, unfortunately, has been lost. 

The artistic language is clearly influenced by contemporary, societal and political factors. One could argue about the multitude of reasons why, but in the end, that won't change the game and it doesn't really matter. 

The facts are as they are, GTA has lots its soul and has gone astray from the legendary behemoth it once was.
